note: The header row of a pane while the canvas is split (stock-ui/pane-header). Size: one of two panes side by side, half of the 1016px main card less the 6px gap between panes (505px), and the stock layout's header height of 28px (`usePaneLook().headerHeight`); the corner variant sits over a 505x120 pane. The pane is named by `id` (a session of the shown workspace, or a file tab's key); its derived values are @perch/sdk `useWorkspaceTabs()` and `usePaneLook()`, recorded in each output's sdk. Whether the pane is focused, in a split or zoomed does not change what the stock header draws (it passes it to a mod's slot only), so those are the same picture; the split state is kept so sdk.workspaceTabs records each tab's pane state.

states.title: An agent that is working: its icon, name, a yellow dot and Working, then the two controls
The other pane of the split, not the focused one: a finished agent (teal dot, Done); drawn the same as a focused one
An agent that waits for the person: a red dot and Waiting for you
A seen, idle agent: a green dot and Idle
A title longer than the room: the name is cut with an ellipsis and the state keeps its width
